title: What Does the Bible Say About War? 27 Verses
description: What the Bible says about war: God as warrior, the call to peacemaking, soldiers who believed, and why war appears in over 230 verses.
keywords: what does the bible say about war
bible verses about war and peace
summary: War is a major subject of Scripture: the words war and wars appear in 232 verses of the World English Bible. The Old Testament records commanded wars, rules of engagement (Deuteronomy 20) and a God who is called a warrior (Exodus 15:3), yet David is kept from building the temple because he shed much blood (1 Chronicles 22:8). The prophets look to a day when swords are beaten into plowshares (Isaiah 2:4). Jesus blesses peacemakers (Matthew 5:9), tells Peter that those who take the sword will die by it (Matthew 26:52) and says his kingdom is not of this world (John 18:36), while Paul says the state does not bear the sword in vain (Romans 13:4). Christians have read these as pacifism, just war or both.

faqs.q: Does the Bible say war is wrong?
faqs.a: It treats war as a result of human sin (James 4:1-2) and honors peacemakers (Matthew 5:9), but it also records wars God commanded in the Old Testament and soldiers who are praised, such as the centurion in Luke 7:9. Churches have drawn different lines: pacifism, just war theory and holy war.

faqs.q: What is a just war and is it in the Bible?
faqs.a: Just war theory comes from Christian thinkers such as Augustine and Aquinas, who drew on Romans 13:1-4, Luke 3:14 and Old Testament rules in Deuteronomy 20. The Bible does not use the term.

faqs.q: What did Jesus say about war?
faqs.a: He said there will be wars and rumors of wars but the end is not yet (Matthew 24:6), told Peter to put away his sword (Matthew 26:52) and said his servants do not fight because his kingdom is not of this world (John 18:36). He also told his disciples to love their enemies (Matthew 5:44).

faqs.q: What does the Bible say about the end of war?
faqs.a: Isaiah 2:4 and Micah 4:3 say nations will beat their swords into plowshares and learn war no more, and Psalm 46:9 says God makes wars cease to the ends of the earth.
